title: First Patterns, Still Wrong
notes: Ben UAT v02 FAIL: wall-to-wall science cards + jars still on fire in older scenery. KEEP one chapter card + ONE teach pop-up (triads). Rest = workshop/study scenery. Candles MAY flame. Jars/pots/canisters NEVER on fire.
physics_lock: Candles may have small natural candle flames only. Jars, pots, canisters, crucibles, flasks MUST NOT emit flames, fire, smoke plumes, or glowing vapor from their mouths. No pots on fire. No jars on fire. Opaque ceramic/metal vessels when jars appear. Silent. No Orbit.

plates.prompt: Premium 3D cartoon 1780s chemist study. Camera drifts along a wooden desk: neat blank specimen cards in a row, OPAQUE lidded ceramic jars and sealed metal canisters sitting cold and closed (never heated). One beeswax candle in a brass candlestick may show a small candle-wick flame — far from the jars. NO spirit lamp. NO burner. NO tripod with fire. NO flame under any pot or jar. Warm window light. Continuous gentle motion. Silent. No readable text. No Orbit. No people. HARD REJECT: jars on fire; pots on fire; burner under a pot; flames from canister mouths.
